headline: A full slate this week: every NFL game from Monday night through next Monday, nine big college games, the Division Series, the NHL's first full week and the WNBA semifinals. Quarterback injuries (Lamar Jackson, Baker Mayfield, Caleb Williams, Washington's QB room) shape the NFL board.
label: Oct 5 – 11, 2026

items: Heisman odds: Jeremiah Smith (Ohio State WR) +115, Darian Mensah (Miami QB) +460, Keelon Russell (Alabama QB) +750. Smith leads FBS with 823 yards and 9 TDs.
Ohio State hosts Maryland Saturday at 4:15 ET (homecoming). Miami has a bye.
Oklahoma is questioning QB John Mateer (6 turnovers in 3 games) before the Red River game. Texas is favored and the total has fallen to about 39.5.
Oregon QB Dante Moore is still in concussion protocol. Dylan Raiola went 19-of-25 for 289 yards and 2 TDs in relief. Oregon -12.5 vs UCLA.
Penn State gave up 413 rushing yards in a 34-13 loss at Northwestern.
LSU QB Sam Leavitt was limited in practice last week. Missouri RB Ahmad Hardy (leg) is still out.
cfb.summary: Week 7 lands Saturday, Oct 10: Georgia at Alabama, Texas vs. Oklahoma, UCLA at Oregon, USC at Penn State, Maryland at Ohio State, Indiana at Nebraska, Texas A&M at Missouri, Ole Miss at Vanderbilt and LSU at Kentucky. Miami is idle.

items: Rays lead the Yankees 1-0 and the White Sox lead the Guardians 1-0. Both ALDS Game 2s are Monday.
Brewers lead the Padres 2-0 after Jackson Chourio's walk-off in Game 2. Braves and Dodgers are tied 1-1.
NLDS Game 3 (Tue): Yamamoto vs. Chris Sale in Atlanta, and Dustin May vs. Nick Pivetta in San Diego.
Aaron Judge (NYY) was left off the ALDS roster on Oct 3 while he recovers from a calf injury.
mlb.summary: Division Series continue all week. NL Game 3s are Tuesday; AL Game 3s are Wednesday.

items: Prop picks start the week of Oct 19 once regular-season lines post.
nba.summary: Preseason. Opening night is Tuesday, Oct 20: Celtics at Pistons, 76ers at Knicks (banner night), Thunder at Spurs.

items: Lamar Jackson (BAL) left Week 4 in a walking boot and has an ankle MRI Monday. Tyler Huntley went 8-of-9 in relief. Baltimore visits Atlanta Sunday night.
Bengals: Ja'Marr Chase (concussion) and Tee Higgins (groin/adductor strain, possibly 2–3 weeks; had 11 catches for 157 yds first) both left the 22-17 loss to Jacksonville.
Washington: Dan Quinn says 'the hope' is Jayden Daniels (elbow) returns in Week 5; Marcus Mariota aggravated his MCL, and rookie Athan Kaliakmanis finished in London.
Justin Jefferson (MIN, ankle sprain) missed Week 4 but the Vikings are hopeful he plays at New Orleans.
Baker Mayfield (dislocated thumb) is out for Week 5, so undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels starts again on Thursday night.
Caleb Williams (hamstring) won't play Week 5, so Tyson Bagent starts at Green Bay. De'Von Achane (MIA) tore his ACL and is out for the season.
Seattle is down to Emanuel Wilson at RB (Charbonnet knee, Price IR). 49ers edge Nick Bosa (calf) is out for multiple weeks. Bills WR DJ Moore re-aggravated his shoulder.
nfl.summary: Week 4 closes tonight with Atlanta at New Orleans. Week 5 opens Thursday with Tampa Bay at Dallas and ends Monday with Buffalo at the Rams. Carolina and Kansas City are on bye.

items: Connor McDavid has 9 points in 3 games, and Edmonton is scoring 5.67 goals a game.
Philadelphia is allowing a league-worst 40.7 shots a game.
Boston's Charlie McAvoy is suspended until Oct 13. Anaheim's Troy Terry is out until November after hip surgery.
Starting goalies aren't confirmed yet for most games, so there are no goalie picks this week.
nhl.summary: The 2026-27 regular season opened Sept 29 (84 games this year). Busy week: 4 games Monday, 9 Tuesday, 10 Thursday, 14 Saturday.

items: Game 1s: Atlanta 92, New York 82; Golden State 71, Las Vegas 60.
Atlanta's Allisha Gray left Game 1 with a left-hand injury, and her Game 2 status is unclear.
Satou Sabally (NY) and Brionna Jones (ATL) were out for Game 1.
No. 8 New York swept No. 1 Minnesota in the first round.
wnba.summary: Semifinals (best of 5) are under way. Game 2s are Wednesday, Game 3s Friday, Game 4s if needed Sunday. The Finals start Oct 17.
